explanation: The worked solution confirms III only. The vector v has rank 2 because (A+9I)v=w≠0 and (A+9I)^2v=0. The vector x has rank 3 because (A−I)^2x=z≠0 and (A−I)^3x=0. Thus I and II are false. Since (A−I)z=0 and z≠0, Az=z, so III is true. The solution's reference to w in its final justification is a typo; the eigenvector there is z.
